comment: The layers may be taken by readers as a guide for sequencing, when in some cases, some component functions may be foundational instead of belonging to the business service layer. For example, The Benefits Package Registry currently sits at the business services layer of the DPI-H reference architecture. In Indonesia and the Philippines where there is one national scheme or a dominant single payer that covers most/all of the population, the Benefits Package Registry determines whether a facility can be contracted or a claim can be paid and therefore behaves more like foundational reference data than a business service.
